state.basis: top4 eigenvectors of centered CPU float64 covariance of all unmasked cached Source encoded_feature tokens; largest absolute entry sign positive

mask: native selected tracked query fixed across all eight frames; logits resize bilinear align_corners=False then sigmoid; mean active anchor xy-max-projection soft Dice
guard_reference: fixed ERef trajectory all physical nodes, D_E=(Ew,Eh,1,1); no GT or temporal filtering

objectives.StateOPD: Gaussian NLL of reward-softmax weighted actual absolute latent candidates
objectives.DirectMC: -logmeanexp(U_k/tau), path gradients through same Gaussian latent candidates, native graph
objectives.DirectFullRef: -U/tau, only restore inter-layer reference gradient in isolated decoder instance; forward unchanged

budget_note: Equal complete-trajectory forward-evaluation allowance, not identical GPU/backward cost; all real proposals and backtracking count, no padding after deterministic rejection, setup equivalence calls separately reported
temporal: reuse exact saved Strong physical MBR interval for all arms
